evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies block index loading and candidate population in src/node/blockstorage.cpp and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Prevents a startup assertion crash loop during AssumeUTXO background sync that leaves nodes unbootable without a complete reindex. If a node restarts while holding the snapshot block without its ancestors, FindMostWorkChain fails with 'Assertion failed: (pindexTest->HaveNumChainTxs() || pindexTest->nHeight == 0)', bricking startup and forcing a wipe of the snapshot chainstate.
